sections.title: Decision Context and Problem Statement
sections.purpose: Establishes what is being decided and why it requires a decision now, so the reviewer can frame the approve/reject judgment against a concrete gap or failure mode rather than a general improvement wish.

sections.title: Proposed Mechanism
sections.purpose: Describes the proposed approach in operational terms: what changes, where it sits relative to the existing path, and what behavior it is expected to produce. Gives the reviewer the object of approval in unambiguous form.

sections.title: Supporting Evidence per Claim
sections.purpose: Ties each load-bearing claim about the mechanism to the specific passage or result that supports it, allowing the reviewer to check the strongest and weakest links rather than accepting the argument as a whole.

sections.title: Qualifications and Limits of the Conclusion
sections.purpose: States the scope conditions, unresolved gaps, and assumptions under which the recommendation holds, so approval is granted with an accurate view of residual risk.

abstention.reason: The blueprint above is structural only. The single listed evidence file, source/001.tex, was not read in this session, so no claim can yet be mapped to a specific passage, result, or figure within it. Section 3 in particular cannot be filled without knowing what the file actually contains; as written it names the file but not the decisive evidence, which is the requirement the task sets. A second limitation: one file is thin support for a memo that must justify both the problem and the mechanism, and it may contain only one of the two. Recommended next step is to read source/001.tex and then either bind each section to identified passages or narrow the memo to the sections that file can support.
